Experiment Beauty recently updated the packaging for its Softwear Smoothing Lip Treatment. The brand switched the layout of the text on the tube so that the front branding artwork faces the camera when the slanted tip is being pressed against the lips.

+1
They did this to optimize the product for social media screens, ensuring the logo is fully visible while creators record application videos. The original formula itself has not changed.

+1
Additionally, the brand recently updated the outer artwork for Super Saturated and Buffer Jelly to unify the product line aesthetic, but the contents remain identical.
